commandText: SELECT d.documentId, d.pathId, d.rootId, d.relativePath, d.title, f.familyId, f.truncated FROM htmlDocuments d LEFT JOIN webFamilies f ON d.pathId = f.entryPathId INNER JOIN webpageClassifications c ON d.documentId = c.documentId WHERE c.value = 'login' ORDER BY d.rootId, d.relativePath
description: Every admitted HTML entry surface classified as a sign-in page, joined to its artifact family and ordered for a stable gallery listing.
